casesPassingDecidingGate: 10/10 at N=20 (200 pairs); negative controls: 3 of 4 fail on both cases, straight-alpha fails on the alpha case
caveats: Oracle is SwiftUI's ImageRenderer at scale 2.5 (decision G50, provisional), not the on-screen NSHostingView path; on-screen confirmation is pending the Mac being free.

Fitted filters per level (G52): none nearest; low and default bilinear; medium bilinear after 2x2 box halvings; high the same halvings with a Mitchell-Netravali cubic (B 0.72, C 0.12), an extra beyond the five named filters.

ratios-checker passes only after G73: the 3x 1 px checker cells at both low and medium measure a per-channel mean of 0.879 (maximum 1 level) and failed the original 0.7 in 20/20 runs. The 0.9 tolerance comes from a calibration page (seed 60) that was added after that failure. It is a named limit, not a fit.
Odd-sized sources reduced by more than 2:1 are not reproduced (G53). `.high` at 1:1 smooths on the Mac, so 1:1 is exact only for none, low, medium and default.

Mac corner spill (G55): the gate lets up to two Mac pixels per cell, in the row just above the cell's top-left corner (x = left-1 and left), be within 60 levels of the ground wherever Windows is exactly ground. This applies to every cell, not only antialiased fractional ones. Measured spill: 1-2 pixels per run in aa, mip and one-to-one.
The transient live-resize path (isLiveResizing) is unit-tested only; there is no settled-capture gate for it. aspectRatio is an Image modifier only.

Gating-set changes made after capture: aa, fill, mip and one-to-one failed the gate at capture time and pass on re-judgement after a gate change that was never committed (the cause for fill is not recorded). The five ratios cases were recaptured after their odd-side >2:1 medium/high cells were removed (G53). Raw captures are not retained; the evidence is the committed reports only.
